Bug_Title: MF: Class defines field that masks a superclass field (MF_CLASS_MASKS_FIELD)
Bug_Details:
This class defines a field with the same name as a visible
instance field in a superclass.  This is confusing, and
may indicate an error if methods update or access one of
the fields when they wanted the other.
Bug_Explanation: The SubClass defines a field named 'value' that masks the 'value' field defined in its superclass, SuperClass. This can lead to confusion and errors when accessing or modifying the 'value' field.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of the SubClass instance, which returns the subclass's 'value' field instead of the superclass's 'value' field.
